title: HttpDownloader: java.io.IOException: thread interrupted

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

Our Bazel builds intermittently fail during analysis when transferring Maven artifacts from an internal Artifactory server. The console only displays a vague error like the following:

```
ERROR: An error occurred during the fetch of repository 'org_apache_neethi_neethi_jar_sources_2_0_4':
   java.io.IOException: thread interrupted
ERROR: .../92b8e37af6d4337248d7dd4b9c25861a/external/vlsi_maven_deps/BUILD:224:1: @vlsi_maven_deps//:org_apache_neethi_neethi_jar_sources_2_0_4_extension depends on @org_apache_neethi_neethi_jar_sources_2_0_4//file:file in repository @org_apache_neethi_neethi_jar_sources_2_0_4 which failed to fetch. no such package '@org_apache_neethi_neethi_jar_sources_2_0_4//file': java.io.IOException: thread interrupted
ERROR: Analysis of target '//vim/vlsi/dist:dist' failed; build aborted: Analysis failed
```

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

Difficult to say. Run lots of builds which download small artifacts from a flaky server?

### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

CentOS 7.2 and macOS High Sierra and Mojave.

### What's the output of `bazel info release`?

release 1.1.0+vmware

### If `bazel info release` returns "development version" or "(@non-git)", tell us how you built Bazel.

na

### What's the output of `git remote get-url origin ; git rev-parse master ; git rev-parse HEAD` ?

na

###  Have you found anything relevant by searching the web?

- https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/3851
- https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/8974#issuecomment-516590432

### Any other information, logs, or outputs that you want to share?

All failures encountered having this signature involved files < 32KB in size, possibly implicating the 32KB precheck logic in HttpStream.java.

----
